rows.text: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Paul Ignatius (DDG 117) completed a historic multi-day maritime transit through the Baltic Sea and the Gulf of Bothnia, arriving in Helsinki Oct. 8 following a successful port visit to Stockholm.
rows.title: US, Sweden, Finland reaffirm trilateral interoperability during historic Gulf of Bothnia transit

rows.text: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Arleigh Burke (DDG 51) entered dry dock at the Navantia shipyard in Cadiz, Spain, Oct. 7, marking the first such evolution in the U.S. 6th Fleet area of operations since the arrival of Forward Deployed Naval Forces – Europe (FDNF-E) destroyers.
rows.title: USS Arleigh Burke enters dry dock in Spain, expanding the U.S. Navy’s forward-deployed maintenance capability in Europe

rows.text: Ships, aircraft, and a submarine from the United States and the United Kingdom concluded Exercise Atlantic Thunder 2026, a multi-domain sinking exercise (SINKEX) led by U.S. 6th Fleet, in the North Atlantic, Sept. 25, 2026.
rows.title: Exercise Atlantic Thunder 2026 Concludes in United Kingdom

rows.text: USS Mount Whitney (LCC 20) hosted Karin Maria Höglund, Swedish Ambassador to Italy, and a Swedish delegation comprised of more than 20 personnel for a comprehensive ship tour in Gaeta, Italy, Sept. 22, 2026.
rows.title: U.S. 6th Fleet Flagship USS Mount Whitney Hosts Swedish Ambassador in Gaeta

rows.text: The U.S. Department of War is participating in the 2026 Marrakech Airshow (MAS) at the Marrakech Royal Moroccan Air Force Base, Oct. 7-10. The highlight of the American Airpower portion will be a dynamic F-35A Lightning II stealth fighter flyby, demonstrating the unmatched, integrated capabilities of the U.S.–Moroccan security partnership in North Africa.
rows.title: Sky-High Alliance: U.S. F-35s and Combat-Ready Wings Celebrate 250 Years of Friendship at 2026 Marrakech Airshow

rows.text: To enhance U.S. warfighter capabilities and deepen regional expertise, U.S. Africa Command partnered with the Africa Center for Strategic Studies (ACSS) to host a five-day seminar at Kelley Barracks focusing on Africa's evolving security landscape and the critical role of enduring partnerships Sept. 28 to Oct. 2, 2026.
rows.title: AFRICOM and ACSS address Africa's contemporary security challenges
